{{Top|leg}}
'''Rolo's Ruffians''' was a group of inmates on the [[Prison/Legends|prison]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Captivity]] led by [[Andews Rolo]]. There were at least twenty-eight members of the group, including a member named [[Volq]]. The group dominated all the other prisoners on the moon, save for a group led by former [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Dedelin]].
